text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "...Alright. In great condition."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While training with Oguri Cap for the NHK 
Mile Cup――

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, you're at it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Looking in pretty good shape there, aren't 
ya!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama! Inari! Are you two out training as 
well?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course it's a sure thing! I'm an 
Umamusume who lives to run, after all!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Then I saw Oguri runnin'. So, I figured 
I'd come check it out while scoutin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She runs with as much sheer force as ever. 
...Goin' up against her is gonna be a real 
threat.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Kiwi?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
T-H-R-E-A-T! Are your ears only tuned to 
words about food?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross, Oguri Cap's roommate, and 
Inari One, their classmate. Both are hot 
prospects this year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite both having small builds, they've 
racked up victory after victory in all 
sorts of races. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Oi, what're ya starin' at? You just 
thought 'So tiny!', didn't ya?!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hah!? That's a forbidden word! Besides, I 
ain't small at all!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No, you're tiny. You're at least smaller 
than me!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat... It was only a centimeter, 
dammit! Oh yeah?! If it's a fight ya want, 
I'll give ya one!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Why are you two fighting? It's just a fact 
that both of you are short.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Keeeh! Urrgh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It's surprisingly heartwarming. Even 
with three of this year's top prospects 
gathered together, the atmosphere is 
anything but tense.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, as I watched everyone frolicking 
about like that—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, you all look like you're having 
fun. Please let me join in too~♪

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Super Creek...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...? Oh my, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Super Creek. Like Oguri Cap, she was a 
standout prospect of their generation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Armed with abundant stamina, she excels 
greatly in long-distance races. Her 
strength is well-known even among 
Trainers.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama, Inari, and Trainer too. Why did you 
all go quiet all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Does your tummy hurt? Are you okay? Shall 
I rub it for you?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That ain't it!! You two are both folk 
who've made quite a name for yourselves 
lately, ain't ya?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Meanin' from the outside lookin' in, we're 
enemies! 'Course everyone around us is 
gonna be on edge!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Super Creek is also one of the top 
contenders in the Classic class.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Depending on her future performances, 
there is no doubt she will become a 
formidable obstacle for Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Oh dear, so you're having trouble with it 
too, Oguri-chan~? Whatever shall we do?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Why?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, you were undefeated back in 
Kasamatsu, right? I've heard all about it~ 
So, so impressive♪"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so? Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Why're ya bashfully acceptin' it?! She was 
mockin' ya with that whole 'Not that we'd 
know out here in the JRA♪' bit!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so? ...Is that really true~?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Are ya really okay with this!? Where's 
your spirit, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Expecting a graceful, elegant fight from 
these two was my first mistake...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How will these two square off in a race? 
To make that happen, we need to build up a 
solid track record at the mile distance!
